title: Canvas manifest
description: The manifest.json of an agent-built UI canvas at /canvases/<name>/manifest.json (stored as canvas:<name>/manifest.json). The canvas renders in a sandboxed, network-less iframe under Canvases.

name.description: Canvas name; must equal the /canvases/<name>/ directory.

title.description: Display title in the Canvases list and page header.

description.description: One or two sentences on what the canvas shows or does.

entry.description: Canvas-relative path of the entry .mjs file; its default export is mount(root, host).

libraries.description: Vendored library ids the canvas imports (see /canvases/_catalogue.json).

artifacts.description: Artifact paths (e.g. 'sales/q3.csv') or folder prefixes ending in '/' (e.g. 'sales/') this canvas visualises from /artifacts/. Shown as its data sources; reads are not restricted to them.
